key_provisions_or_claims: Symposium held 28-30 Oct 2025 in Bishkek for Central Asia, Iran and Pakistan with 37 participants
Promotes equitable, ethical, human-centred AI in education
Human dimension concept (Holmes): AI should support human flourishing, not replace human thinking
Aligned with UNESCO AI Ethics Recommendation, GenAI guidance, and AI competency frameworks
Emphasises AI literacy and teachers as key drivers
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: UNESCO news item on a regional symposium in Bishkek (28-30 October 2025) on ICT and AI in education for Central Asia, Iran and Pakistan. It promotes equitable, ethical, human-centred AI use in education, building on UNESCO's AI ethics Recommendation and AI competency frameworks. It has no robotics content.
annotation.title_clean: Empowering the Future of Digital Learning: UNESCO Initiated Regional Dialogue on Equitable, Ethical and Human-Centred Use of ICT and AI in Education
